QuestInfo.name: Helping Don Giovanni with His Problem
QuestInfo.0: Time to gently interrogate the people of Kerning City, as Ryden instructed. Talk to #bDon Giovanni of the Hair Salon#k.
QuestInfo.1:
Don Giovanni wants you to buy a gift from the #bSecret Garden#k for his son. He wants you to get the #bToy Plane#k.

Tip: You can get the item required from #p1055002# in #m103050300#.
QuestInfo.2: Don Giovanni says the Dark Lord often takes walks in the Swamp Region.

0.0: Ah! Someone is here to make their hair FABULOUS! No? Then why are you here?
0.1: Ah, the Dark Lord sent you to be of service. I know just the thing! My son, Icarus, he is a tender, gentle soul. This world is too much for him! I want to cheer his heart...
0.2: He has always dreamt of flight, so he must have a #bToy Plane#k! My friend, do you think you can get me one?

0.msg: I need a Toy Plane! Don't make me a terrible father.

1.msg: Ryden said you could get the item you need from #b#p1055002# in #m103050300##k. Don't fail me now!\r\n

1.0: The Toy Plane! Thank you, my friend. My son will be pleased. I knew the Dark Lord would send someone reliable to help his beloved people of Kerning City.

0.msg: Do I know the Dark Lord? Well, in a sense. He's friendly enough. He cherishes Kerning City, but he doesn't really have anyone close to him. #rI run into him sometimes in the Swamp Region, where he takes walks by himself.#k

1.msg: #b(You've finished investigating everyone that Ryden mentioned. Wait for him to contact you.)

item.0: You haven't brought the #bToy Plane#k yet?
